chapter: Sounds and recording in old New Orleans
title: Hearing bands and parades from afar before the Magnolia project
summary: Alcorn recalls hearing dance bands, parade drums and bass tuba from blocks away, which the new buildings killed.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
